Comment: Hardware TSO via PROT_SAO. Litmus-proven on POWER8/hash (2026-08-13); on a
host that cannot do SAO the startup probe refuses and FEX falls back to
emitted barriers on its own, so this is safe to ship unconditionally.
In-world it measured +10-15 fps (lwsync 2.48% -> 0.17% of cycles).
enableavx: the old -16% (2026-08-10) was a WARMUP MIRAGE -- DXVK's on-disk
pipeline cache persists across sessions and the cold leg ran first. Re-run
scene-matched): AVX-on 46.9 fps p95 25.4 / p99 27.6 vs off 44.1 / 28.6 /
32.5 -> +6.3% avg, p95 -11%, p99 -15%. No crash under AVX+HWTSO. Global
AVX default stays off (glibc-IFUNC string-op tax); this title carries it
per-app. Revert = remove the HostFeatures line.
